# Source-fidelity report

Read in full: source.md (brief, underlag, boundaries) and draft.md. Language: Swedish. This report compares support, not style or mechanics. No direct quotations occur in the draft, so no translated-quotation findings apply.

## Exact source passages used below

S1 — Brief: ”Skriv en debattartikel för invånarna i fiktiva Lervik. Avsändare är Sanna Ek, talesperson för föreningen Öppna beslut. Tes: kommunstyrelsen bör skjuta upp ett permanent byte till enbart digital bokning av föreningslokaler och först pröva ett halvår med både telefon och webb.”

S2 — ”Kommunens pilotrapport Bokning av föreningslokaler, 8 april 2026, gäller ett åtta veckor långt försök i två lokaler. Under försöket gjordes 96 bokningar via webb och 24 via telefon.”

S3 — ”Rapporten räknar bokningar, inte unika personer. Den mäter inte ålder, funktionsförmåga eller digital vana. Telefonbokningarna kan därför inte användas för att säga hur stor andel av invånarna som inte kan boka digitalt.”

S4 — ”Tjänsteutlåtandet inför kommunstyrelsens möte den 18 juni föreslår att telefonbokning tas bort för alla sju lokaler från september.”

S5 — ”Motivet i utlåtandet är att personalen ska slippa föra in uppgifter i två flöden. Någon tidsmätning eller ekonomisk besparingsberäkning finns inte i handlingarna. Förvaltningens verkliga invändning mot att behålla båda kanalerna är dubbel administration, inte att telefonanvändare är lata eller dyra.”

S6 — ”Öppna beslut föreslår ett sex månader långt försök i alla sju lokaler, med båda bokningsvägarna kvar. Under försöket ska förvaltningen registrera tidsåtgång per bokningsväg och be användarna frivilligt ange varför de väljer telefon eller webb.”

S7 — ”Föreningen gör inget anspråk på att ha finansierat eller kostnadsberäknat försöket. Kostnaden behöver kommunstyrelsen ta ställning till. Därefter kan den avgöra om en kanal ska tas bort, ändras eller behållas.”

S8 — ”Sanna Eks ståndpunkt: ’Att en bokning går via telefon är inte ett bevis för att någon inte kan använda webben. Det är ett skäl att ta reda på varför telefonen fortfarande används.’ Detta får citeras eller refereras. Hon menar att kommunen först måste kunna väga arbetskostnaden mot värdet för användarna. Hon motsätter sig inte digital bokning.”

## Claim accounting

Each item gives draft passage, independently checkable standalone proposition (P), its precise negation (N), and the supplied passage that excludes N. Source references resolve to the exact quotations above. Normative statements are tested as authorized advocacy or attributed stance, not as empirical predictions or objective proof of policy necessity. Coordinated lists are split below where independently checkable.

1. Passage: title, ”Pröva båda bokningsvägarna innan telefonen tas bort”. P: The article advocates trying telephone and web booking before removing telephone booking. N: The article's advocated ordering does not put trying both channels before removing telephone booking. Support: S1 explicitly supplies that advocated ordering; S6 specifies the retained channels. This is an exhortation, not a claim that removal has already been decided.

2. Passage: ”Kommunstyrelsen i Lervik bör skjuta upp ett permanent byte till enbart digital bokning av föreningslokaler.” P: Sanna advocates that Lervik's municipal executive postpone a permanent move to exclusively digital booking of association premises. N: Sanna does not advocate that postponement. Support: S1's explicit thesis and author attribution.

3. Passage: ”Vi i Öppna beslut föreslår ett halvår med både telefon och webb i alla sju lokaler.” P: Öppna beslut proposes a six-month trial retaining telephone and web booking in all seven premises. N: Öppna beslut does not propose a six-month trial retaining both channels in all seven premises. Support: S6, with S1 supporting the half-year wording. All duration, scope and channel modifiers retained.

4. Passage: ”Kommunen behöver kunna väga arbetskostnaden mot värdet för användarna innan den stänger en bokningsväg.” P: Sanna's position is that the municipality must first be able to weigh labor cost against user value before closing a booking channel. N: Sanna's position does not require that comparison before channel closure. Support: S8, read with S1's postponement thesis. This is attributed advocacy, not proof of an external legal requirement.

5. Passage: byline ”Sanna Ek, talesperson för föreningen Öppna beslut”. P: The article's speaker is Sanna Ek. N: The article's designated speaker is not Sanna Ek. Support: S1.

6. Same passage. P: Sanna Ek is the spokesperson for the association Öppna beslut. N: Sanna Ek is not that association's spokesperson. Support: S1, exact role and organization.

7. Passage: heading ”Bokningarna berättar inte varför”. P: The reported booking counts do not establish why users selected their channels. N: The reported booking counts establish why users selected their channels. Support: S2 supplies only channel counts; S8 expressly proposes finding out why the telephone is used. This heading is scoped by the immediately following discussion of counts. No broader claim that the entire report contains no reason data is made.

8. Passage: ”Kommunens pilotrapport Bokning av föreningslokaler, daterad den 8 april 2026”. P: The municipal pilot report is titled Bokning av föreningslokaler. N: That municipal pilot report is not titled Bokning av föreningslokaler. Support: S2.

9. Same passage. P: That report is dated 8 April 2026. N: That report is not dated 8 April 2026. Support: S2.

10. Passage: ”redovisar 96 webbokningar ... under åtta veckor i två lokaler”. P: The report records 96 web bookings during an eight-week trial in two premises. N: The report does not record 96 web bookings during that eight-week trial in two premises. Support: S2. Duration and two-premise limitation retained.

11. Passage: ”och 24 telefonbokningar under åtta veckor i två lokaler”. P: The report records 24 telephone bookings during the eight-week trial in two premises. N: The report does not record 24 telephone bookings during that eight-week trial in two premises. Support: S2.

12. Passage: ”Det visar att båda vägarna användes i försöket.” P: Both telephone and web booking were used in the trial. N: At least one of telephone and web booking was not used in the trial. Support: S2's positive count for each channel excludes N.

13. Passage: ”Det säger inte varför användarna valde som de gjorde.” P: Those counts do not establish the users' reasons for choosing their booking channels. N: Those counts establish the users' reasons for choosing their booking channels. Support: S2's counts and S8's distinction between telephone use and reasons for it; same limited numerical inference as item 7. The sentence does not assert knowledge about all information the municipality might hold elsewhere.

14. Passage: ”Rapporten räknar bokningar”. P: The report counts bookings. N: The report does not count bookings. Support: S3.

15. Passage: ”inte unika personer”. P: The report does not count unique persons. N: The report counts unique persons. Support: S3.

16. Passage: ”Den mäter varken ålder”. P: The report does not measure age. N: The report measures age. Support: S3.

17. Passage: ”funktionsförmåga”. P: The report does not measure functional ability. N: The report measures functional ability. Support: S3.

18. Passage: ”eller digital vana”. P: The report does not measure digital familiarity. N: The report measures digital familiarity. Support: S3.

19. Passage: ”Därför går det inte att använda telefonbokningarna som mått på hur stor andel av Lerviks invånare som inte kan boka digitalt.” P: Because the report counts bookings rather than unique persons and does not measure age, ability or digital familiarity, its telephone-booking count cannot measure the share of Lervik residents unable to book digitally. N: Despite those counting and measurement limitations, that count can measure the share of Lervik residents unable to book digitally. Support: S3 explicitly makes the same inference; S1 supplies Lervik. No share or incapacity is invented.

20. Passage: ”Att en bokning görs via telefon bevisar inte att någon saknar förmåga att använda webben.” P: A booking's being made by telephone does not prove a person's inability to use the web. N: A booking's being made by telephone proves a person's inability to use the web. Support: S8, meaning-equivalent paraphrase. It does not claim everybody can use the web.

21. Passage: ”Men det är ett skäl att undersöka varför telefonen fortfarande används.” P: Sanna regards continued telephone use as a reason to investigate why it is used. N: Sanna does not regard continued telephone use as a reason to investigate why it is used. Support: S8.

22. Same passage, circumstantial implication. P: Telephone booking is still used in the situation being discussed. N: Telephone booking is no longer used in the situation being discussed. Support: S8's ”fortfarande används”, supplemented by S2. No additional duration or post-removal use is asserted.

23. Passage: ”Ett beslut om att ta bort den bör bygga på mer än antalet bokningar i respektive kanal.” P: Sanna advocates a basis for removing telephone booking that extends beyond per-channel booking counts. N: Sanna does not advocate any basis beyond per-channel booking counts for that removal decision. Support: S8's labor-cost/user-value comparison and S6's requested measurements. This is a supported elaboration of the stated position, not an assertion that the existing decision rests exclusively on counts.

24. Passage: heading ”Dubbel administration behöver mätas”. P: The article advocates measuring the administrative work associated with the two channels. N: The article does not advocate measuring that administrative work. Support: S5 identifies the administration issue; S6 asks for time per booking channel; S8 supplies the cost comparison. No measured burden is asserted.

25. Passage: ”Tjänsteutlåtandet inför kommunstyrelsens möte den 18 juni”. P: The cited official memorandum is for the municipal executive's meeting on 18 June. N: The cited memorandum is not for that meeting on 18 June. Support: S4. The draft does not add a year to this date.

26. Passage: ”föreslår att telefonbokningen tas bort för alla sju lokaler från september”. P: That memorandum proposes removing telephone booking for all seven premises from September. N: That memorandum does not propose removing telephone booking for all seven premises from September. Support: S4. It remains a proposal, not an adopted decision or completed removal.

27. Passage: ”Förvaltningens invändning mot två bokningsvägar är dubbel administration”. P: The administration objects to retaining two channels because of double administration. N: The administration does not object to retaining two channels because of double administration. Support: S5 explicitly identifies the actual objection. No invented attitude toward telephone users.

28. Passage: ”personalen ska slippa föra in uppgifter i två flöden”. P: The stated motive is to spare staff entering information in two flows. N: Sparing staff entry in two flows is not the stated motive. Support: S5. This describes motive, not a measured saving or a guaranteed outcome.

29. Passage: ”Det är en relevant invändning.” P: The author evaluates the double-administration objection as relevant to this decision. N: The author does not evaluate that objection as relevant to this decision. Support: S8 explicitly insists on weighing labor cost; S5 identifies the genuine administration objection. This is an editorial evaluation consistent with that stance, not a new factual magnitude claim.

30. Passage: ”handlingarna innehåller varken någon tidsmätning”. P: The documents contain no time measurement. N: The documents contain a time measurement. Support: S5. No assertion is made that nobody anywhere performed a measurement.

31. Passage: ”eller någon ekonomisk besparingsberäkning”. P: The documents contain no financial-savings calculation. N: The documents contain a financial-savings calculation. Support: S5. This is not a claim that savings are zero or that no calculation exists outside the documents.

32. Passage: ”Att hänvisa till dubbel administration räcker inte för att visa hur mycket arbete som skulle försvinna”. P: A reference to double administration, without a time measurement in the documents, is insufficient to demonstrate how much work removal would eliminate. N: That reference without such a measurement demonstrates how much work removal would eliminate. Support: S5 provides a qualitative motive and expressly absent quantitative measurement. A quantitative amount is not entailed by the qualitative existence of two flows; item 32 asserts insufficiency, not zero reduction.

33. Passage: ”eller vilken besparing förändringen skulle ge”. P: A reference to double administration, without a savings calculation in the documents, is insufficient to demonstrate the amount of savings the change would produce. N: That reference without such a calculation demonstrates the amount of savings the change would produce. Support: S5's expressly missing calculation and qualitative motive. The draft introduces no specific savings, guarantee of savings, or claim that savings are impossible.

34. Passage: ”Jag motsätter mig inte digital bokning.” P: Sanna Ek does not oppose digital booking. N: Sanna Ek opposes digital booking. Support: S8 explicitly excludes N.

35. Passage: ”Min invändning gäller underlaget för att göra den till enda alternativet.” P: Sanna's objection concerns the decision basis for making digital booking the sole option. N: Sanna's objection does not concern the decision basis for making digital booking the sole option. Support: S1's postponement thesis, S8's required prior comparison, and S5's missing measurements. The objection is given no invented personal history or motive.

36. Passage: ”Kommunstyrelsen bör kräva ett underlag som gör det möjligt att bedöma både arbetet med bokningarna och telefonens värde för användarna.” P: Sanna advocates that the municipal executive require information enabling assessment of booking labor and telephone booking's user value. N: Sanna does not advocate requiring information enabling that dual assessment. Support: S8's explicit comparison, operationalized by S6. No actual level of user value is asserted.

37. Passage: heading ”Besluta om ett halvår med båda vägarna”. P: The article advocates deciding on a half-year trial with both booking channels. N: The article does not advocate deciding on such a half-year trial. Support: S1 and S6.

38. Passage: ”Öppna beslut föreslår därför ett sex månader långt försök i samtliga sju lokaler.” P: Öppna beslut proposes a six-month trial in all seven premises as its answer to the need for a better basis for evaluating channels. N: Öppna beslut does not propose a six-month trial in all seven premises as its answer to that need. Support: S6 and S8. ”Därför” expresses the article's supported policy reasoning, not an invented historical cause of an event.

39. Passage: ”Under försöket ska förvaltningen registrera tidsåtgången för varje bokningsväg”. P: Under Öppna beslut's proposed six-month trial in all seven premises, the administration would be tasked with recording time spent per booking channel. N: That proposed trial does not task the administration with recording time spent per booking channel. Support: S6, exact attribution, trial scope and proposed status.

40. Passage: ”och be användarna frivilligt ange varför de väljer telefon eller webb”. P: Under that proposed trial, the administration would ask users to volunteer their reasons for choosing telephone or web. N: Under that proposed trial, the administration would not ask users to volunteer those reasons. Support: S6. Voluntariness, agency and channel choices preserved.

41. Passage: ”Vi gör inget anspråk på att ha kostnadsberäknat ... försöket.” P: Öppna beslut makes no claim to have costed the proposed trial. N: Öppna beslut claims to have costed the proposed trial. Support: S7. The draft carefully does not assert that costing has not happened.

42. Passage: ”eller finansierat försöket”. P: Öppna beslut makes no claim to have financed the proposed trial. N: Öppna beslut claims to have financed the proposed trial. Support: S7. The draft does not turn absent assertion into absent financing.

43. Passage: ”Kommunstyrelsen behöver ta ställning till kostnaden.” P: The municipal executive needs to consider the proposed trial's cost. N: The municipal executive does not need to consider that cost. Support: S7 expressly states this required consideration. No cost amount is supplied.

44. Passage: ”Förslaget får alltså inte behandlas som en kostnadsfri lösning.” P: The author advocates that the proposed trial should not be treated as an established cost-free solution. N: The author permits treating the proposed trial as an established cost-free solution. Support: S7 requires a cost decision and disclaims claiming a costing. This is a caution against assuming zero cost; it does not assert a known positive incremental cost. A zero-cost trial remains source-compatible, and nothing in the wording rules it out as an eventual finding. No repair required.

45. Passage: ”Kommunstyrelsen bör skjuta upp det permanenta bytet”. P: Sanna advocates that the municipal executive postpone the permanent move to digital-only booking. N: Sanna does not advocate that postponement. Support: S1. Same warranted thesis as item 2, preserved in conclusion.

46. Passage: ”ta ställning till kostnaden”. P: Sanna advocates that the municipal executive consider the trial's cost. N: Sanna does not advocate that cost consideration. Support: S7. The conclusion retains the uncertainty.

47. Passage: ”och besluta om ett halvår med båda bokningsvägarna kvar”. P: Sanna advocates a decision for a half-year trial retaining telephone and web booking. N: Sanna does not advocate a decision for a half-year trial retaining both channels. Support: S1 and S6. Scope of the trial remains all seven premises from preceding paragraphs; no different scope implied.

48. Passage: ”Därefter kan den avgöra om en kanal ska tas bort, ändras eller behållas”. P: After the proposed process, the municipal executive can decide whether a channel should be removed, changed or retained. N: After that proposed process, the municipal executive cannot decide among removing, changing or retaining a channel. Support: S7 explicitly names the same timing and three alternatives. This describes the available subsequent policy decision, not certainty that the trial produces decisive results.

49. Passage: ”med arbetskostnaden och värdet för användarna som grund för avvägningen”. P: The author's proposed subsequent channel decision weighs labor cost and user value. N: The author's proposed subsequent channel decision does not weigh labor cost and user value. Support: S8's exact comparison. This is the advocated decision framework, not a prediction that both quantities will certainly be measured without error.

## Separate pronoun and agreement accounting

The following records person, number and natural gender independently from referent resolution. Every explicit pronoun occurrence is included. Swedish grammatical gender of inanimate nouns is not an assertion of human natural gender.

A. Opening ”Vi i Öppna beslut” and closing ”Vi gör inget anspråk”: referent is the association represented by speaker Sanna Ek. P: These are first-person plural institutional utterances including the authorized speaker; neither specifies natural gender. N: They are not first-person plural institutional utterances including the authorized speaker. S1 assigns Sanna the association spokesperson role, and S6–S7 assign exactly these proposals/disclaimers to the association, licensing its collective voice. This does not supply or imply an exact membership count or particular members' genders.

B. Opening ”innan den stänger”: ”den” refers to the municipality, third-person singular, common grammatical gender. P: The proposed actor is the singular municipality. N: The proposed actor is not that municipality. S8 names ”kommunen” and S1 identifies the municipal decision. No natural gender assertion.

C. ”Det visar” and ”Det säger”: each demonstrative ”Det” refers to the preceding recorded numerical information, grammatically singular neuter, third person, without personal or natural-gender features. P: Each sentence's evidential subject is the report's just-stated counts. N: Its evidential subject is something other than those counts. S2 supplies exactly that information; immediate syntax fixes scope. The words do not denote a male or female source.

D. ”varför användarna valde som de gjorde”: ”de” is third-person plural, refers to users, and asserts no natural gender. P: The discussed bookers are collectively users choosing booking channels, without a specified number of unique people. N: The discussed bookers are not collectively users choosing booking channels. S6 itself uses ”användarna” and ”de väljer telefon eller webb”; S8 discusses why telephone is used. The plural does not transform 120 bookings into 120 people. Source wording supports generic plural users without an exact population count.

E. ”Den mäter”: third-person singular common grammatical gender, refers to report. P: The measuring subject is that singular report. N: The measuring subject is not that report. S3 uses the same reference and grammatical form. No natural gender.

F. ”Därför går det inte”: ”det” is an impersonal/expletive grammatical pronoun, singular neuter, with no asserted entity, natural gender or person count. No independent factual proposition is added.

G. ”Att ... någon saknar förmåga”: ”någon” is an indefinite singular human pronoun, not gender-specific; it occurs inside what the booking does NOT prove. P: The draft rejects proof of any person's inability from telephone booking alone. N: The draft affirms such proof of a person's inability from telephone booking alone. S8 explicitly states the rejection. It asserts neither an actual disabled individual nor natural gender.

H. ”Men det är ett skäl”: third-person singular neuter demonstrative, refers to telephone booking/use. P: Telephone booking/use is the circumstance offered as the reason to investigate. N: Some circumstance other than telephone booking/use is the offered reason. S8 supplies that exact argument. No natural gender.

I. ”ta bort den” in the sentence beginning ”Ett beslut”: third-person singular common grammatical gender, refers to telephone booking/telephone channel. P: Telephone booking is the channel whose removal is discussed. N: The removal discussed concerns a different channel. S1 and S4. No natural gender.

J. ”Det är en relevant invändning”: third-person singular neuter demonstrative with the double-administration objection as referent. P: The evaluated objection is double administration. N: The evaluated objection is not double administration. S5 identifies that objection; S8 supports its relevance to the cost comparison. No natural gender.

K. ”Jag” and ”Min” in the third body section: first-person singular and first-person singular possessive respectively, identify authorized speaker Sanna Ek; neither Swedish form asserts natural gender. P: The non-opposition and objection are assigned to the single named author Sanna Ek. N: They are not assigned to that single named author. S1 names the author and S8 expressly assigns the stance to Sanna. ”Min” agrees grammatically with ”invändning”, not with a human gender. Source S8 uses ”Hon”, but the draft does not assert gender via ”jag/min”.

L. ”göra den till enda alternativet”: third-person singular common grammatical gender, refers to digital booking. P: Digital booking is the option being considered as sole option. N: A different booking option is being considered as sole option. S1's digital-only thesis and S4's telephone-removal proposal. No natural gender.

M. ”ett underlag som gör det möjligt”: ”som” is a relative pronoun referring to singular ”underlag”, with no person or natural-gender assertion; ”det” in ”gör det möjligt” is formal/expletive, without an independently asserted entity. P: The demanded basis is to enable the specified assessment. N: The demanded basis is not to enable that assessment. S8 supplies the assessment requirement; S6 supplies the informational proposal. The assessment itself is covered in item 36.

N. ”varför de väljer telefon eller webb”: third-person plural ”de”, users of the proposed trial, gender-unspecified. P: Proposed trial users are to be asked, collectively and voluntarily, about their channel choices. N: Proposed trial users are not to be asked collectively and voluntarily about their channel choices. S6 uses the same plural and channels. This neither predicts an exact number of users nor asserts natural gender.

O. Final ”Därefter kan den avgöra”: third-person singular common grammatical gender, refers to the municipal executive (kommunstyrelsen). P: The subsequent deciding body is the singular municipal executive. N: The subsequent deciding body is not the municipal executive. S7 explicitly assigns that role and uses ”den”. No natural gender.

Additional quantifiers/references: ”båda” consistently denotes the two named channels (S1, S6); ”alla/samtliga sju” denotes seven premises (S4, S6); ”varje bokningsväg” distributes proposed recording across channels (S6), not across every individual booking; ”vilken besparing” asks about an unknown amount (S5) rather than asserting a quantified saving. Their subjects, scope and negations are covered in items 3, 10–12, 26, 33, 38–40 and 47. No natural-gender assertion occurs in these forms.

## Findings

No source-support defect found. The strongest potential ambiguity is item 44, but its explicit ”får ... inte behandlas som” is advocacy against an unsupported assumption. It does not claim known nonzero cost. The sentences disclaiming costing and financing preserve the precise state of knowledge: absence of an organizational claim, not proof of absence of either activity.

No invented external events, legal duties, discrimination cases, protests, savings, motive, personal experience, scene, magnitude evaluation or named person's gender was found. The actual pilot report is named where numbers bear the argument. No quotation or translation issue applies. No repair proposed.

Completion status: COMPLETE. Every factual/attributed assertion and advocacy-bearing heading in the complete draft has been accounted for, with separate pronoun-feature review. Unresolved findings: none.
